name: Large Language Models for Mortals: A Practical Guide for Analysts with Python

mentions.name: Large Language Models for Mortals: A Practical Guide for Analysts with Python
mentions.description: A practical guide book teaching analysts how to use foundation model APIs with Python. It covers calling the APIs, structured outputs, RAG, and MCP/agents, with up-to-date examples for the major providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and AWS Bedrock), plus a chapter on LLM coding tools such as Copilot, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
